chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Five things are as I say: there is no comfort for a miser, no pleasure for an envious person, no loyalty for a slave, no honor for a liar, and a foolish person does not attain leadership.

key_terms.بَخِيلٍ: a miserly person who withholds what should be given
key_terms.حَسُودٍ: an envious person who resents the blessings of others
key_terms.يَسُودُ: to become a leader or attain mastery

ai.seo_question: What qualities prevent a person from finding peace, honor, and leadership in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith presents five concise moral judgments about blameworthy traits and their consequences. It teaches that certain vices deprive a person of inner peace, dignity, trustworthiness, and suitability for leadership.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5838 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Five things are exactly as I say:
A miser will never find comfort,
A jealous person will never experience pleasure,
A slave will not have loyalty,
A liar will have no honor,
And a foolish person will never attain leadership."
